title: Yellow Pillowy Korean Gelatin Anju
description: A funky and crowd-pleasing Korean dish featuring unflavored gelatin, this anju is a smoke-hot and buddhist-temple-friendly treat, served in a lacquerware bowl.
instructions: In a small bowl, dissolve the gelatin in 1 cup of water and let it sit for 5 minutes.
In a medium saucepan, combine the gochugaru, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar, and whisk until the sugar is dissolved.
Add the water to the saucepan and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the dissolved gelatin to the saucepan and stir until it is fully incorporated.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
Just before serving, sprinkle the toasted sesame seeds and scallions over the top of the gelatin.
Serve the gelatin in lacquerware bowls and enjoy.
Garnish with additional scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
